_how: The site's rollout settings: three of them. (1) assetsBase: the public https address of the assets folder once it is published (no slash at the end), for example https://assets.example.com/site . null in the review build. When it is set, every page names its own link-preview picture, <assetsBase>/derived/share/<slug>.jpg, as og:image and twitter:image; when it is null those two tags are left out and the build says so. See ADD-A-PAGE.md section 10. (2) review: true in the review build, and only then does every footer end with the line 'Review build. Nothing on this page is sent anywhere...'. For rollout set it to false (or remove it) and build again: no page and no GoHighLevel block then carries that line. Only the exact value true turns the line on, so a build without the setting is a rollout build. PP_REVIEW=1 or PP_REVIEW=0 in the environment sets it for one build without editing this file; check-site reads the same setting and fails a page that disagrees with it. (3) headerText: true puts a Text button into the phone top bar, straight before the gold button (the same sms: link as every other Text link; only under 1180px wide, where the bar has no Text or call control of its own). false, or the line left out, builds the header without it; only the exact value true turns it on. It changes the header of every page and nothing else, so after changing it build every page and package again: only the header blocks differ. PP_HEADER_TEXT=1 or PP_HEADER_TEXT=0 in the environment sets it for one build without editing this file; check-site reads the same setting and fails a page whose header disagrees with it.
